name: StartupPerks Open Dataset
description: Every startup credit, perk, and deal StartupPerks tracks: the provider, category, headline benefit value, eligibility (stage, funding cap, geography), and a link to the provider's own official page. Curated from official sources, dated, and refreshed weekly. Free to use with attribution.
attribution: Data from StartupPerks (https://startupperks.co), licensed CC BY 4.0.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Stable unique identifier for the program.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Program name as the provider presents it.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: The company offering the perk.

fields.name: provider_slug
fields.description: Provider identifier (matches /providers/[slug]).

fields.name: category
fields.description: Category key, e.g. cloud-infra, ai-ml, banking-fintech.

fields.name: category_label
fields.description: Human-readable category label.

fields.name: benefit_type
fields.description: Kind of benefit: Credits, Discount, Free, Cash & rewards, etc.

fields.name: value_text
fields.description: Headline benefit value exactly as the provider states it.

fields.name: value_usd
fields.description: Maximum headline value in USD. Null when the amount is non-USD, a partner-bundle total, or a billing threshold (never additive).

fields.name: eligibility
fields.description: Primary funding/backing gate, e.g. Any startup, VC / accelerator-backed.

fields.name: stages
fields.description: Startup stages that qualify (empty means any stage).

fields.name: max_funding_raised_usd
fields.description: Maximum total funding raised the program allows, if any.

fields.name: max_company_age_years
fields.description: Maximum company age in years the program allows, if any.

fields.name: geographies
fields.description: Regions the program is open to (empty means global).

fields.name: recurring_or_expiry
fields.description: Whether the benefit recurs or when it expires, as stated.

fields.name: other_requirements
fields.description: Any other stated requirement (e.g. new customers only).

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: How well-verified the record is: high, medium, or low.

fields.name: last_verified
fields.description: ISO timestamp this record was last re-verified against the source, or null if only in the dated static catalog.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: The provider's official page stating the terms (the source of record).

fields.name: apply_url
fields.description: The provider's own application URL.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The StartupPerks page for this program.

records.name: Fondo Tax Credits + Startup Bookkeeping (YC partner deal)
records.value_text: Up to $500,000 per year in R&D tax credits
records.recurring_or_expiry: R&D credit claimed annually; you only pay if Fondo recovers money.
records.other_requirements: R&D credit payroll offset generally requires under $5M in gross receipts and US employees/contractors doing product development. The 15% fee cap requires being a Y Combinator company (referral-gated); the standard cap is 20%.

records.name: Google for Startups Cloud Program
records.value_text: Up to $200,000 USD in Google Cloud (up to $350,000 USD for AI startups)
records.recurring_or_expiry: Credits span two years; one-time enrollment.
records.other_requirements: Under 5 years old; not raised beyond Series A (within last 12 months); not a prior Google Cloud program participant. Scale tier requires equity funding (SAFEs qualify); Start tier open to unfunded. No equity taken.

records.name: Brex for Startups (partner perks)
records.recurring_or_expiry: Ongoing perks; individual partner offers have their own terms.
records.other_requirements: Card eligibility historically favors funded/professionally-backed startups; perks accessible to Brex account holders. Perk values are aggregated third-party offers.

records.name: Ramp for Startups / Partner Rewards
records.recurring_or_expiry: Ongoing; review of perk eligibility takes 1-2 business days.
records.other_requirements: Explicitly non-dilutive (no equity). Perk values are aggregated third-party partner offers.

records.name: Cloudflare for Startups
records.other_requirements: Building a software/SaaS product, founded within last 5 years, valid website and matching email. Direct applications accepted for lower tiers; $100K/$250K require an approved partner. Non-dilutive.

records.name: Snowflake Startup Program / Startup Accelerator
records.other_requirements: Early-stage company building on Snowflake; credit tier depends on stage and partner validation.

records.name: Databricks Startup Program
records.value_text: Up to $200k in credits across Databricks and Neon
records.other_requirements: Must be venture-backed and building data/AI-driven applications, recently raised institutional funding (pre-seed to Series A).

records.name: Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub
records.recurring_or_expiry: Credits allocated over the program period (staged); one enrollment.
records.other_requirements: Base $5K tier broadly open (privately held, building a software/AI product, not previously enrolled). $100K-$150K tiers require an Investor Network referral code from a partnered VC/accelerator. No equity taken.

records.name: Pinecone for Startups
records.value_text: Free access to Pinecone's Standard Tier and Pro Support, plus usage credits and discounts
records.recurring_or_expiry: $5K over 6 months (unfunded) or up to $150K over 2 years (funded).
records.other_requirements: Higher credit tier requires having raised institutional funding.

records.name: Mixpanel for Startups
records.value_text: First year free on the Startup Plan
records.other_requirements: Incorporated less than five years ago; must implement (send data) within 90 days.

records.name: Alibaba Cloud Startup / AI Catalyst Program
records.recurring_or_expiry: Credits valid ~1 year (AI Catalyst lifetime); rolling applications, ~4-5 business day review.
records.other_requirements: AI must be the core technology. Private company, typically under 5-10 years old, not a heavy cloud spender; live website or working prototype. AI Catalyst track skews APAC.

records.name: IBM Startup Program (Global Entrepreneur)
records.other_requirements: Revenue under $1M in last 12 months, operating under 5 years, no prior IBM technology credits, not already a paying IBM Cloud customer. Non-dilutive.

records.name: Akamai Cloud Rise Startup Program
records.value_text: Up to US$120,000 in cloud credits during the first year
records.other_requirements: Under 7 years old, working website, corporate email, and at least one of: paid employees beyond founders, active external users, or initial revenue. Prioritizes SaaS, media, gaming.

records.name: OVHcloud Startup Program
records.value_text: Up to €100,000 of free cloud credits
records.recurring_or_expiry: 12-month credit window per level; headline value in EUR (USD approximate).
records.other_requirements: Tech-focused, under 5 years old, fewer than 50 employees, revenue below EUR 10M. Start = pre-seed/seed; Scale = Series A. No equity taken.

records.name: Oracle for Startups
records.other_requirements: Generally under 10 years old with an MVP. $100K levels typically come through accelerator/VC partnerships. Non-dilutive.

records.name: DigitalOcean Hatch
records.recurring_or_expiry: 12-month credit window; award level set per partner.
records.other_requirements: Must have raised $10M or less; matching corporate email; registered DigitalOcean team account. Prioritizes AI-native startups. Service businesses (agencies, consulting) ineligible.

records.name: Render for Startups
records.recurring_or_expiry: One-time credit grant; tier set at application.
records.other_requirements: Apply through a registered Render accelerator or VC partner; tier scales with funding. Top $100K AI tier requires $2.5M+ raised and compute-intensive workloads.

records.name: Neon Startup Program
records.other_requirements: Top tier ($100K) requires VC-backed or recognized accelerator; self-funded track requires under $1M raised and an early-stage product/MVP.

records.name: Claude for Startups (Anthropic Startup Program)
records.other_requirements: Raised institutional equity funding, founded within last 4 years, not previously received Anthropic startup credits. Non-funded founders can join but do not get credits.

records.name: NVIDIA Inception
records.other_requirements: Incorporated, under 10 years old, at least one developer, working website. Excludes consulting firms, crypto, cloud providers, resellers, public companies. Cloud credits accessed via partner programs.

records.name: Datadog for Startups
records.other_requirements: Pre-seed, seed or Series A with a VC or accelerator referral (must be in the Datadog partner network); company-domain email and real website.

records.name: Grafana Labs Startup Program
records.value_text: Up to $100,000 in Grafana Cloud credits
records.recurring_or_expiry: 12 months or until next funding round
records.other_requirements: Ideally under $10M raised and under 25 employees (soft guidelines, encouraged to apply otherwise). Must agree to be a reference customer.

records.name: Deepgram Startup Program
records.value_text: Up to $100,000 in credits over 12 months
records.recurring_or_expiry: Credits must be used within 12 months; review within ~1 week, credits deposited 24-48h after acceptance.
records.other_requirements: Must be an AI builder or early-stage startup, in production or launching within the next 6 months, and committed to actively building and engaging with the Deepgram community.

records.name: Aiven Cluster Startup Program
records.value_text: Get up to $100,000 in Aiven credits
records.other_requirements: Startup 7 years old or younger, raised between pre-seed and Series B, applying with a business email address.

records.name: Airbyte Startup Program (YC)
records.recurring_or_expiry: Credits applied to Airbyte Cloud usage.
records.other_requirements: Must be in a current or any previous Y Combinator batch, have raised under $5M total, and be a new (not existing) Airbyte customer.

records.name: Modal Startups
records.recurring_or_expiry: Credits valid 12 months; one-time per tier.
records.other_requirements: New to Modal (not an existing paid customer), and either backed by a Modal VC partner or raised over $1M (Seed-Series A). Needs a live product or strong technical team.

records.name: Fivetran Startup Program
records.other_requirements: Headline offer requires Y Combinator membership; Fivetran may backcharge companies not meeting eligibility.

records.name: Together AI Startup Accelerator
records.value_text: Up to $50K in free platform credits
records.other_requirements: Credit tier set by total funding raised. No equity required.

records.name: Atlassian for Startups
records.value_text: Premium edition of our products for $0 for 12 months
records.recurring_or_expiry: Free for 12 months, up to 50 users.
records.other_requirements: Not an existing Atlassian paid customer; raised no more than $10M in external funding; VC-backed or accelerator/incubator affiliated.

records.name: PostHog for Startups
records.recurring_or_expiry: Credits valid for 12 months from approval.
records.other_requirements: Company less than two years old and raised less than $5M in total funding; must create a PostHog account first.

records.name: fal Startup Deals (a16z / Entrepreneur First partners)
records.other_requirements: Access is via fal's partner programs (e.g., a16z portfolio, Entrepreneur First); a separate fal ventures Generative Media Fund invests up to $250K per team in cash plus fal credits.

records.name: Amplitude Startup Scholarship
records.value_text: One year of the Growth plan at no cost
records.recurring_or_expiry: Free for 12 months; then upgrade to Growth or revert to the Free plan.
records.other_requirements: Fewer than 20 employees.

records.name: Vercel for Startups
records.other_requirements: Raised Series A or less; apply within 12 months of the most recent round; no prior Vercel for Startups credits; matching email domain.

records.name: Baseten for Startups (AI Startup Program)
records.value_text: Up to $25,000 in credits for Dedicated Inference or Training and up to $2,500 in credits for Model APIs
records.recurring_or_expiry: Credits must be consumed within 6 months of grant date.
records.other_requirements: Net-new customers only: must never have received any credits from Baseten before.

records.name: Retool for Startups
records.value_text: $25,000 in Retool credits in the first year
records.other_requirements: Bootstrapped, angel/debt-funded, pre-seed, seed, or Series A; raised less than $10M total; founded within the past 10 years.

records.name: WorkOS for Startups
records.recurring_or_expiry: Enterprise features free for up to 12 months, then paid ($125/connection/month standard).
records.other_requirements: Early-stage startup with a company-domain email and a live product website matching the application. No equity required. Review typically 1-3 weeks.

records.name: Runpod Startup Program
records.recurring_or_expiry: Growth tier is a 12-month agreement; Starter credits are a one-time grant.
records.other_requirements: Venture backing strongly preferred for the Growth tier (most accepted startups raised Seed-Series B+); Starter tier open to earlier-stage teams with real AI workloads. Applications reviewed holistically.

records.name: Auth0 for Startups
records.value_text: One year of Auth0, free for your startup
records.recurring_or_expiry: Free for one year, then standard pricing.
records.other_requirements: Must be venture-backed with under $5M total funding, under $1M ARR, and under 2 years from incorporation. Excludes existing paid Auth0/Okta customers and prior program members. Apply with a company-domain email and live website.

records.name: Confluent for Startups
records.value_text: Up to One Year of Confluent Cloud
records.recurring_or_expiry: Includes one year of technical support.
records.other_requirements: Founded within last 5 years (Series B or earlier, with exceptions), new to Confluent (not a Commit customer), not previously received Confluent credits.

records.name: CircleCI Startup Program
records.recurring_or_expiry: Promotional period up to 24 months or until credits consumed
records.other_requirements: Must be new to CircleCI or on the Free plan; founded within the last 5 years; part of a recognized accelerator/VC OR proof of minimum $500K raised. Credit amount and duration vary by stage and location.

records.name: AssemblyAI Startup Program
records.recurring_or_expiry: 12 months of recurring monthly credits; allocations scale with usage.
records.other_requirements: Early-stage teams building voice/Speech AI products.

records.name: MotherDuck Startup Program
records.value_text: $16,000 worth of MotherDuck for an $8,000 annual commitment
records.other_requirements: Less than $5M in funding (bootstrapped welcome), fewer than 20 employees, and a new customer or existing Free-plan customer.

records.name: Notion for Startups
records.value_text: Up to 6 months free on the Business plan with Notion AI included
records.recurring_or_expiry: Credit applied for 1-6 months depending on tier; one redemption per company; does not stack.
records.other_requirements: New, non-paying Notion customer, under 100 employees, building a scalable tech product, live website and company-domain email (not Gmail/Outlook). Service/agency businesses get a lower tier.

records.name: Fireworks for Startups
records.other_requirements: Non-dilutive, no equity. AI-native startups needing fast inference (pre-seed through Series B).

records.name: GitHub for Startups
records.recurring_or_expiry: 12-month benefit period; Year 2 50% off if partner-qualified.
records.other_requirements: Funded up to Series A or affiliated with a GitHub for Startups partner; new to GitHub Enterprise (or not on Enterprise in the past 6 months); not previously received these credits.

records.name: Drata for Startups
records.recurring_or_expiry: Discount applies to first contract; investor must be on Drata's participating-firm list.
records.other_requirements: Must have an investor on Drata's list of participating venture firms (or have Drata onboard them); pursuing SOC 2 / ISO 27001. Open seed through Series B.

records.name: Algolia for Startups
records.other_requirements: Must be less than 3 years old, raised less than $5M, and a new Algolia customer with no prior coupon code used.

records.name: LangSmith for Startups
records.recurring_or_expiry: Startup Plan lasts 1 year before graduating to the Plus Plan (2 years for YC).
records.other_requirements: Build tier requires being a first-time customer with less than $10M in funding and having raised at least $25K in seed funding; Scale tier available to startups backed by LangChain's VC/accelerator partners.

records.name: ClickHouse Cloud Startup Program (Y Combinator)
records.other_requirements: Current or past Y Combinator company, pre-Series D, and new to ClickHouse Cloud. A separate broader Cloud Startup Program exists with criteria on the program site.

records.name: Lambda for Startups (Cloud Credits)
records.other_requirements: Best fit for startups with an active GPU workload. No equity required.

records.name: Zoom for Startups
records.value_text: One year of Zoom Workplace Business Plus for up to 25 seats
records.recurring_or_expiry: One year free (up to 25 seats) or 30% off first year.
records.other_requirements: Pre-seed to Series A, fewer than 50 employees, affiliated with a select Zoom startup partner, not an existing paid customer.

records.name: MongoDB for Startups
records.recurring_or_expiry: Credits valid 12 months after activation; 12-month window to activate.
records.other_requirements: Under 7 years old, Series A or earlier, building a single scalable software product (not an agency), with a website. 12 months to activate the code, then 12 months to use credits.

records.name: Elastic for Startups
records.other_requirements: Early-stage startup; specific caps vary by partner channel.

records.name: Lambda Research Grant
records.other_requirements: Requires academic/research affiliation and a research proposal; for research, not commercial startups.

records.name: Sentry for Startups
records.recurring_or_expiry: Credits expire 1 year after joining; one offer per company, no stacking.
records.other_requirements: Founded in the last 2 years, raised less than $5M in venture capital, new to paying for Sentry (prior free plan OK).

records.name: Every.io Free Incorporation + All-in-One Back Office
records.recurring_or_expiry: Incorporation is free one-time; back-office platform is a recurring subscription from $25/mo.
records.other_requirements: Aimed at US Delaware C-Corp founders; state filing fees may still apply.

records.name: Perplexity for Startups
records.value_text: 3 months of free Perplexity Enterprise Pro for up to 50 seats, plus $5k in API credits
records.recurring_or_expiry: 6 months of Enterprise Pro; API credits are a one-time grant.
records.other_requirements: Company must be less than 5 years old, have raised under $20M in equity, and be associated with one of Perplexity's approved Startup Partners (accelerator/VC).

records.name: ElevenLabs Startup Grants
records.recurring_or_expiry: 12-month grant; rolling applications, decision within ~1 week.
records.other_requirements: Fewer than 25 employees; legitimate business model and monetization strategy; valid business email; not building for children under 18. Agencies, consulting firms, and existing enterprise customers are not eligible. One application per company.

records.name: Vercel Open Source Program
records.recurring_or_expiry: 12 months of credits per accepted cohort; reapply per cohort.
records.other_requirements: Must maintain a qualifying open-source project. Cohort-based applications. Not funding-gated.

records.name: Supabase Startup Program
records.other_requirements: Under 5 years old, under $5M total funding (pre-seed to Series A), verified affiliation with an approved VC firm or accelerator.

records.name: ClickUp for Startups
records.other_requirements: Must be affiliated with an approved funding partner, have raised no more than a Series B round, be incorporated within the last 5 years, and be new to ClickUp or on the Free Forever plan.

records.name: Stripe Atlas (Incorporation + Credits + Perks)
records.recurring_or_expiry: $100 annual registered-agent renewal after year one; fee-waiver capped by revenue threshold.
records.other_requirements: Must form (or have recently formed) a company through Stripe Atlas. $500 formation fee is paid, not a free perk. Processing fee waiver applies to US card charges up to the revenue cap.

records.name: Airtable for Startups
records.recurring_or_expiry: Credit amount varies by application channel.
records.other_requirements: Bootstrapped/pre-seed/seed stage; company-domain email and real website required.

records.name: 1Password for Startups
records.recurring_or_expiry: Free trial period ~6 months, then standard pricing; OSS free tier is ongoing.
records.other_requirements: Redeemed via partner/accelerator programs (e.g., Founder Club, Brex Marketplace $100 credit) rather than a single public 1Password page; needs a company-domain email and verifiable startup profile.

records.name: Tiger Cloud Startup Credits
records.other_requirements: Trial credit is for new users; larger amounts require partner/sales engagement.

records.name: Miro Startup Program
records.recurring_or_expiry: Credit value depends on partner vs individual channel.
records.other_requirements: Incorporated within the last 7 years, raised no more than $10M, 30 or fewer employees, live website, not primarily a service/consulting firm.

records.name: Brex New Customer Sign-Up Bonus
records.other_requirements: New Brex business customers only; US-incorporated business with an EIN (no sole proprietors). Approval based on cash balance/funding. Spend or deposit threshold and deadline apply.

records.name: Deel Startup Program (Free HR + Perks + New-Customer Credit)
records.recurring_or_expiry: Free HR ongoing; annual-commit discounts require yearly plans.
records.other_requirements: Free HR tier for smaller teams. The $500 credit and preferred rates often via partner/VC programs (e.g. FounderPass). EOR discounts require annual/multi-year commitment.

records.name: Mercury Business Banking + New Account Cash Bonus
records.recurring_or_expiry: One-time bonus per new account; promo terms subject to change.
records.other_requirements: New Mercury customers only; US-incorporated business (LLC or C-corp) with an EIN. Not for sole proprietors. Deposit threshold within 90 days.

records.name: Netlify Open Source / Nonprofit Program
records.recurring_or_expiry: Plan-level discount; new users get a monthly free credit allotment.
records.other_requirements: Open-source or verified nonprofit status; valid .edu email (via GitHub Student Pack) for student Pro. No general VC-backed startup credit program currently published.

records.name: Fly.io Startup / Promo Credits
records.recurring_or_expiry: Promo credits one-time and small; core model usage-based.
records.other_requirements: Requires a credit card; promo credits are partnership-specific and limited. No formal VC/accelerator-gated credit tier.

records.name: CoreWeave Startup Accelerator Program
records.other_requirements: Credit amount negotiated per company and not published. AI/ML-focused, compute-intensive workloads.

records.name: dbt Labs Startup Perk (via Google for Startups Cloud)
records.other_requirements: Requires Scale Tier membership in the Google for Startups Cloud Program (pre-seed to Series A and VC/accelerator association).

records.name: CockroachDB for Startups
records.other_requirements: Terms governed by the CockroachDB Cloud Credits Supplement; amount not publicly fixed.

records.name: PlanetScale for Startups
records.other_requirements: Eligibility and credit amount vary by partner route.

records.name: Hugging Face Startup Program
records.recurring_or_expiry: Discount applies to Enterprise Hub Year 1.
records.other_requirements: Open to bootstrapped, pre-seed, and seed startups; no equity required. No VC referral required.

records.name: Cohere Startup Program
records.other_requirements: Open to startups with Series B funding or earlier.

records.name: Rho Business Banking + Treasury (New Account Cash Bonus)
records.recurring_or_expiry: Promo bonus terms rotate; treasury yield variable.
records.other_requirements: New Rho customers; US-incorporated business. Treasury yield requires a $100k minimum. Deposit-bonus threshold ($20k in 60 days) tied to a specific promo.

records.name: Arc Treasury & Cash Management for Startups
records.other_requirements: US-incorporated startups (Arc primarily serves venture-backed tech companies). Higher tiers are paid subscriptions; yield variable.

records.name: Meow Business Banking for Startups
records.recurring_or_expiry: Yield variable; account free tier ongoing.
records.other_requirements: US-incorporated business. Meow is a fintech, not a bank; services via partner banks. Yield variable.

records.name: Every.io Free Startup Incorporation Bundle
records.value_text: 100% free to use, no annual fees or commitments
records.recurring_or_expiry: Free incorporation and banking ongoing; bookkeeping/tax bundles priced separately.
records.other_requirements: New Delaware C-corp formations. Free incorporation contingent on using Every's bundled banking/payroll. Bookkeeping and tax filing are paid add-ons.

records.name: AngelList Stack (Free Incorporation + Cap Table)
records.recurring_or_expiry: Free tier ongoing; FUM-based fees apply to fund products.
records.other_requirements: For US Delaware C-corps. Free cap table tier for basic use; AngelList charges 0.25-1% of funds under management on fund/RUV products.

records.name: Carta Launch (Free Cap Table Tier)
records.recurring_or_expiry: Free while under the stakeholder and funding caps; converts to paid beyond them.
records.other_requirements: Free tier limited to 25 or fewer stakeholders AND under $1,000,000 raised. Crossing either limit moves you to paid plans. 409A valuations require a paid plan.

records.name: Rippling for Startups (Months-Free Promo)
records.recurring_or_expiry: Time-limited free months on new subscriptions.
records.other_requirements: 6-months-free tier requires VC-backed status; 3-months-free targets startups under ~100 employees. Typically via accredited partner platforms. New customers only.

records.name: Gusto Payroll (New-Customer Free Months Promo)
records.recurring_or_expiry: Intro promo on new accounts; standard pricing after.
records.other_requirements: New Gusto customers only; US business with employees or contractors. Free-months length varies by channel; $100 reward requires a first payroll.

records.name: Vanta for Startups
records.value_text: Save $1,000 with the Vanta for Startups program
records.recurring_or_expiry: Partner discount typically applies to the first custom plan.
records.other_requirements: New Vanta customer only; cannot combine with other Vanta promotions or an existing sales engagement.

records.name: GitLab for Startups
records.other_requirements: Externally funded only (bootstrapped not eligible). Pre-seed/seed up to $5M raised; Series A/B up to $20M.

records.name: Linear for Startups
records.other_requirements: Fewer than 50 employees; must be affiliated with an official Linear partner (no open/self-serve path).

records.name: Postman for Startups
records.other_requirements: Eligibility details not officially published; verify directly with Postman.

records.name: Slack for Startups
records.recurring_or_expiry: Discount applies for 12 months; not combinable with other Slack promotions.
records.other_requirements: No more than 200 employees; new to paid Slack; company-domain email and live website.

records.name: Framer for Startups
records.value_text: Save $360 instantly with a full year of the Framer Pro plan at zero cost
records.recurring_or_expiry: 100% off first year of the Startup plan.
records.other_requirements: New Framer user (no existing account with a published website), pre-seed or seed stage, live website and business email (not personal Gmail/Outlook). Agencies/service businesses excluded.

records.name: HubSpot for Startups
records.recurring_or_expiry: Discount steps down over 2-3 years by tier.
records.other_requirements: 90% tier: raised pre-seed/seed/Series A under $20M (not Series B+) AND affiliated with an approved partner or verified venture funding. 30% tier: associated with an approved entrepreneurial organization.

records.name: Customer.io Startup Program
records.value_text: Up to 12 months of Customer.io free
records.recurring_or_expiry: Free for the first year, then an exclusive startup offer at renewal.
records.other_requirements: Must not be a current or former Customer.io customer; contacts must be obtained through standard (non-purchased) methods.

records.name: Apollo for Startups
records.other_requirements: Fewer than 20 employees, no existing Apollo subscription, a valid company domain, and affiliation with an Apollo startup ecosystem partner (VC, accelerator or community).

records.name: Typeform for Startups
records.value_text: 75% off the Business plan for a year
records.recurring_or_expiry: 75% off for one year, on an annual plan.
records.other_requirements: Seed stage, less than $1M in funding and less than $1M in lifetime revenue; must not be an existing Typeform customer.

records.name: ActiveCampaign Incubator (Startup Program)
records.value_text: 90% off any ActiveCampaign annual plan for the first year
records.recurring_or_expiry: 90% off first year; full price thereafter.
records.other_requirements: Must be a current incubator partner or alum within the past 12 months, a new ActiveCampaign customer, and cannot have raised more than $1M.

records.name: Braze for Startups
records.other_requirements: Must be a VC-backed startup, typically routed through a participating VC partner.

records.name: Tally for Startups
records.other_requirements: New customer; distributed via Tally partner organizations. Funding/age caps (under ~$2M, under ~3 years) reported by partner listings, not stated in Tally's official page.

records.name: Brevo Startups & VCs Program
records.recurring_or_expiry: Partner-dependent; discount terms and duration vary by partner.
records.other_requirements: New Brevo customer (no prior paid plan); typically requires affiliation with an accredited partner.

records.name: Sprinto for Startups

records.name: Yandex Cloud Boost
records.value_text: Cloud credit grant for startups (Start: $600, or Migrate: up to $12,000) plus service discounts
records.recurring_or_expiry: One-time grant, approved in ~1 week; includes 1 year priority support, then a 20% ongoing discount.

records.name: Selectel Startup Grant (and AI Project Support)
records.value_text: Up to 1,000,000 rubles (~$11,000) in bonuses over 12 months via a 30% monthly cashback mechanism; a separate AI-project program grants up to 2,000,000 rubles (~$22,000).
records.recurring_or_expiry: 12-month program with recurring 30% monthly cashback bonuses.

records.name: VK Cloud Startup Support
records.value_text: Grant of up to 2,000,000 rubles (~$22,000) for cloud infrastructure; Startup Village participants also get 50-100% discounts on IaaS/PaaS for 6 months.

records.name: CloudMTS Startup Grant
records.value_text: Grants of up to 10,000,000 rubles (~$110,000) in cloud services: up to 1M rubles at 100% for 3 months, or 1-10M rubles covering up to 70% for 6 months.
records.recurring_or_expiry: 3 to 6 month grant terms; +30% discount for 1 year after grant completion.

records.name: Timeweb Cloud Grant
records.value_text: Grant of up to 1,000,000 rubles (~$11,000) usable on any Timeweb Cloud service for up to 6 months.
records.recurring_or_expiry: Up to 6 months; open-ended intake that may pause when capacity is exhausted.

records.name: Cloud.ru for Startups (Test Evolution start grant)
records.value_text: Start grant of 4,000 bonuses (1 bonus = 1 ruble) on card linking, plus discounted startup conditions across Evolution cloud services.
records.recurring_or_expiry: Start grant valid 60 days; startup offers are ongoing.

records.name: Cloud4Y Startup Support
records.value_text: Up to 1,000,000 rubles (~$11,000) in cloud resources, spendable without restriction across any Cloud4Y service.
records.recurring_or_expiry: Rolling; grant valid for a fixed development period.

records.name: Denvr AI Ascend
records.value_text: $1,000 in startup credits to begin, with eligible teams able to receive up to $500,000 in production AI-compute credits.
records.recurring_or_expiry: Ongoing, rolling applications; production credits sized to the team.

records.name: Prime Intellect Fast Compute Grants and Startup Credits
records.value_text: $500 to $100,000 in GPU compute credits via Fast Compute Grants, plus $2,000 in compute credits through the startup program.

records.name: Neysa AI Velocity Program
records.value_text: Escalating discounts on cloud consumption plus, at commercial traction, credit reimbursement plans, over a 21-month partnership.

records.name: NeevCloud for Startups (free cloud credits)
records.value_text: Promotional free cloud credits (e.g. ₹15,000 / ~$180 in CPU cloud credits) plus reduced GPU pricing for AI startups.
records.recurring_or_expiry: Promotional credits with limited validity; offers rotate.

records.name: Cudo Compute Free Credits
records.value_text: $300 in free credits for new customers to run, test and deploy workloads, plus 25+ products usable free up to monthly limits.
records.recurring_or_expiry: One-time new-customer signup credit; free monthly product tiers ongoing.

records.name: AWS Activate Founders
records.recurring_or_expiry: Activate credits are valid up to 2 years from the date of issue; one-time enrollment.
records.other_requirements: Pre-Series B and founded within the last 10 years. Requires an AWS account on a paid support plan (not the free tier). Must be new to Activate credits, or requesting more than previously received. Self-funded / bootstrapped (not affiliated with an AWS Activate Provider).

records.name: AWS Activate Portfolio
records.recurring_or_expiry: Activate credits are valid up to 2 years from the date of issue; one-time enrollment.
records.other_requirements: Pre-Series B and founded within the last 10 years. Requires an Organization ID from an AWS Activate Provider (your accelerator, angel, or VC must be an Activate Provider). AWS account on a paid support plan. Must be new to Activate credits, or requesting more than previously received.
